name: Karela Chips
steps: Cut bitter gourd into very thin rings and remove only the hard mature seeds; keep the scalloped green edges.
Rub with part of the salt and turmeric, rest until moisture gathers, then squeeze dry without crushing the rings.
Toss with chili powder, remaining salt, rice flour, gram flour and lemon juice so each slice has a thin dry coating.
Fry small batches in medium-hot oil, separating stuck rings, until bubbling slows and the edges turn crisp.
Drain on a wire rack and cool; the chips crisp further as steam escapes.
tips: Keep the bitter gourd slices thin and dry; thick wet rings remain chewy instead of crisp.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
